title: Support ticket routing
instruction: Route this customer support message to the one team that should handle it first.

labels.name: Billing
labels.definition: Questions or complaints about charges, invoices, refunds, prices, taxes or payment methods.

labels.name: Bug report
labels.definition: Something in the product is broken, behaves wrongly or loses data.

labels.name: Account access
labels.definition: Trouble signing in, resetting credentials, verifying identity or managing who can access an account.

labels.name: How-to
labels.definition: The customer asks how to do something with features that already exist.

labels.name: Feature request
labels.definition: The customer asks for something the product does not do yet, or suggests an improvement.

labels.name: Cancellation
labels.definition: The customer wants to cancel a plan, close an account or stop being charged because they are leaving.

business_rules: Any message labelled cancellation always goes to a human retention agent, whatever the model's confidence.
Low-confidence predictions go to the general queue instead of a team queue.
